Ravi: Noticed a billing blip on the canary; double confirmed tokens after a retry across regions.
Jo: can you paste a trace snippet?
Ravi: sanitized: 
```
2026-03-23T08:12:03Z trace=tr-23-08 req=rq-221 route=us-west-2 client_session=cs-221 toolcall_id=tc-11 provisional=1500 truncated_at=1496
2026-03-23T08:12:07Z client retried -> routed to eu-west-1 req=rq-221 client_session=cs-221 toolcall_id= (missing) provisional=1500
2026-03-23T08:12:12Z ledger: both provisional -> confirmed -> charged 3000 tokens
```
Kelsey: So dedupe depends on toolcall_id. Retry without it = second provisional.
Jo: Is this only toolcalls?
Ravi: More common with toolcalls (longer responses), but normal streaming can hit it too when truncation + retry happen.
Kelsey: Short term: create an ops reconcile that looks for same client_session+req within 30s across different routes and flag suspects. Long term: propagate a flow id across routing.
Jo: I like a header X-RW-Flow-Id. Gateway should set on ingress and copy when re-routing. Use as primary dedupe key when present.
Kelsey: Also emit provisional_origin tags (route, host, flow_id) in traces so console can show where provisional vs confirmed diverge.
Ravi: For immediate mitigation: Grafana alert when confirmed_tokens_by_route / provisional_tokens_by_route > 1.4 in a 5m window, plus a reconcile runbook to surface refunds.
Jo: Add metric for requests missing both toolcall_id and flow_id so we can spot clients who never set idempotency.
Kelsey: I'll own the flow-id gateway change (feature-flagged canary). Ravi -> open billing ticket for reconcile. Jo -> console/telemetry tags.
matt-billingbot: created BLG-2026-99 and pinged @billing-team (auto)
Ravi: thanks, will follow up with PR links in this thread.
